payload.title: Enforce domain-mirrored functional test layout
currentProgress: The intended functional suite shape is documented under docs/temp/functional-tests-expansion/.
Destination paths use domain nouns: transport, workers, orchestration, workstations, work, sessions, factory, and supporting domains.
The old transport-first features/ layout and catch-all packages (smoke, workflow, runtime_api) must not remain valid long-term owners.
payload.requestedOutcome: Update the normative backend standard and packaged-structure guidance, then teach make pkg-structure to require tests/functional/<domain>/<subsection>/... while preserving tests/functional/internal/support as the only shared harness exception. Reject new shallow, catch-all, or unclassified scenario packages.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/internal/standards and packaged-structure docs describe the domain tree from the functional-tests-expansion plan.
make pkg-structure accepts the intended domain layout and rejects new catch-all or unclassified functional packages.
tests/functional/internal/support remains the only shared support exception.
runtime_api remains deletion-only debt and cannot receive new scenarios.
verification: Focused structure-checker tests for the new layout rules

payload.title: Parse functional test metadata with the Go AST
currentProgress: The visualization plan requires inventorying every top-level Test* with its first Go-doc sentence.
No durable AST-backed metadata parser yet exists for functional catalog generation.
payload.requestedOutcome: Implement a Go AST-backed parser that inventories top-level Test* declarations, Go doc comments, build constraints, and golden declarations under tests/functional. Exclude helpers and tests/functional/internal/** from customer counts, and add an exact deletion-only undocumented-test baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: Parser returns stable metadata for file, package, Test* name, description, build tags, and golden references.
Helper-only files and tests/functional/internal/** are excluded from customer scenario counts.
An exact undocumented-test baseline exists and is deletion-only.
Focused tests cover malformed source, Windows paths, build tags, table tests, and Markdown-sensitive descriptions.

payload.title: Expose deterministic coverage JSON from gocoveragecheck
currentProgress: cmd/gocoveragecheck already enforces functional statement-coverage floors.
The visualizer must not invent a second coverage parser.
payload.requestedOutcome: Add optional JSON output to cmd/gocoveragecheck that reports covered/measurable statements, percentage, package floor, and measurement exception while preserving existing behavior when the option is absent. Write results after a completed run even when a floor fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Optional JSON output is deterministic and machine-readable.
Existing non-JSON behavior remains unchanged when the option is absent.
Failed floors still emit JSON diagnostics after the run completes.
Focused tests cover totals, package floors, and exception reporting.

payload.title: Add provider-session golden harness and tracked fixture root
currentProgress: The golden contract is documented in provider-session-goldens.md.
docs/temp/** is gitignored today, so the fixture root needs a narrow tracked exception.
payload.requestedOutcome: Add a narrow .gitignore exception for docs/temp/functional/provider-sessions/**, implement manifest validation and golden loading/normalization helpers, and ensure missing goldens fail clearly rather than silently skipping. Compare Provider Session, response-event, and invocation-result goldens using only manifest-declared normalized fields.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/temp/functional/provider-sessions/** is tracked despite the general docs/temp ignore.
manifest.json validation rejects secrets, absolute host paths, credentials, and unsanitized prompts.
Helpers load request/process/stdout/stderr and expected public metadata goldens.
Expected output rewrite requires an explicit update environment variable.
Missing required goldens fail with actionable diagnostics.
verification: git check-ignore / tracking proof for the fixture root

payload.title: Map existing functional tests onto the domain destination tree
currentProgress: The destination checklist is domain-mirrored under tests/functional/<domain>/...
Existing catch-alls such as smoke, workflow, guards_batch, bootstrap_portability, replay_contracts, and runtime_api still own scenarios.
payload.requestedOutcome: Produce a migration ledger that maps every current functional scenario to one checklist destination file or an approved wrong-layer rationale. Preserve short/long membership and specialty Make targets, and identify deletion-only batches for runtime_api and featureless catch-alls.
acceptanceCriteria: Every current scenario maps to one destination checklist cell or an approved non-functional layer.
runtime_api, smoke, workflow, guards_batch, bootstrap_portability, and replay_contracts have explicit move/split plans.
Short/long membership and specialty Make targets are preserved in the ledger.
The ledger is durable under docs/temp/functional-tests-expansion/ and usable by later move batches.
verification: Ledger completeness against current tests/functional inventory

payload.title: Review Wave 0 foundation outcomes before viz and domain cells
payload.requestedOutcome: After the independent Wave 0 foundations complete, reconcile queue evidence, decide whether to submit FND-004/FND-005 (Markdown generator and make/CI integration) next, and only then open Wave 1 domain cells whose harness prerequisites are satisfied.
